row:
Dr Sandhu has over 20 years experience in chiropractic... successfully treating thousands of people with a variety of symptoms from low back pain, neck pain, shoulder, elbow, wrist, hand, upper, mid back, pelvis, hips, legs, knee, ankle, feet pain and sprain/strains. With gentle, non invasive Chiropractic Adjustments.

 " Our Mission here at the Clinic is to find and treat the cause of your symptoms. To mobilise your all important nervous system thereby allowing your body to function optimally, so you can live and enjoy your life without symptoms. Through ongoing education about the right exercise and nutrition we can help you your family and loved ones get the best out of your body and life. We want to create a healthy Bedfordshire Community." Surinder Sandhu.

Contact us on 01234 353937 to book a no obligation consultation.
www.thebedfordchiropractor.co.uk
